title.purpose: One per screen: the screen's name.

caption.purpose: Descriptions, table headers, help text, metadata.

shadows.name: shadow-overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus and toasts only; nothing at rest casts a shadow.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-action-primary-background, #3161ff); color: var(--color-action-primary-foreground, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-action-primary-background-hover, #244dd6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A supporting action next to the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-action-secondary-background, #ececef); color: var(--color-action-secondary-foreground, #1a1a21); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-action-secondary-background-hover, #d9d9df); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Inline and tertiary actions: copy, remove, tree.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-action-ghost-foreground, #1a1a21); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-action-ghost-background-hover, #ececef); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); }

components.name: Danger button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--color-action-danger-background, #c73b40); color: var(--color-action-danger-foreground, #fff); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-action-danger-background-hover, #a32f33); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text entry; the border carries focus and error.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a21); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #8a8a96); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); font: 400 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-secondary, #5c5c69); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-border-danger, #e5484d); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status pill; the label carries the meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 13px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge[data-tone="neutral"] { background: var(--color-status-neutral-background, #ececef); color: var(--color-status-neutral-foreground, #2a2a33); } .ds-badge[data-tone="success"] { background: var(--color-status-success-background, #e1f5e8); color: var(--color-status-success-foreground, #1f7a45); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised surface with a hairline; stacks header, body and actions.
components.html:
Weekly report

12 components changed, 3 tokens added.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 12px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a21); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #d9d9df); border-radius: var(--radius-container, 12px); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #5c5c69); } .ds-card-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3161ff; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1a1a21; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ececef; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Peer views of one subject; selection is color plus a 1px underline.
components.css: .ds-tablist { display: flex; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #d9d9df); } .ds-tab { margin: 0 0 -1px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #5c5c69); font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-bottom-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[data-selected] { color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a21); } .ds-tab[data-selected] { border-bottom-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-border-focus, #3161ff); }

narrative.overview:
The portal is a bench where a designer tunes a design system against real pages. Everything on it is an instrument or the thing being measured, so the chrome recedes and the catalog reads. Resonant describes itself as calm, precise and unhurried: neutral surfaces, one blue for action, status colors only where a state must be read, small radii, hairline borders, generous inset. The portal is built from Resonant and edits Resonant, so the portal's own look is nothing more than Resonant applied to a tool; when the system changes, the chrome changes with it.

Density is moderate: tables and lists run dense, editing panels stay roomy. Hierarchy comes from weight and surface, not size; the four type roles sit within a 13 to 20px band. Light is the base theme; dark is an overlay that swaps surfaces, text, borders and status tints and leaves the action blue alone.
keyCharacteristics: One family (Inter), four roles, weight does the hierarchy work.
One blue, used for actions, focus and the current selection only.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; a shadow appears only under overlays.
Tokens, not values: the portal's CSS binds to --color-*, --space-*, --radius-* variables that Resonant emits.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The action blue marks what the user can do next or where they are: primary action, focus, selection, link. It never tints a heading, a panel or a decoration.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: A status color is always a background and foreground pair from the same hue; text on a tint is the hue's deep step, never gray.

rules.name: The Close Sizes Rule
rules.body: No text on the portal is larger than 24px or smaller than 12px. Emphasis is weight or tone, never size.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth is a 1px border or a tone step. A shadow means the element floats above the page and can be dismissed.

dos: Do bind every color, space, radius and type value in the portal to a Resonant token variable.
Do keep one primary button per screen and put it last in a row of actions.
Do show the current place twice: the sidebar item and the breadcrumb or title.
Do separate groups with spacing first and a hairline only when they still blur.
donts: Don't write a raw color or pixel value into portal styles; add a token to Resonant instead.
Don't use the action blue for anything that is not an action, focus, selection or link.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces or nest cards inside cards.
Don't use exclamation marks, emoji or a component's name as a title in product copy.
